## Notes

- Job description: `references/lanes/skills.md`. Write paths (verified this shift): `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name`; `--ack-through=ID` for body refreshes), `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (`--add`/`--remove`, labels on PRs too), `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` (`--title-file` / `--body-file` / `--label`; title cap 256 bytes), `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (`issue_patch`, `comment_edit`, `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, `pr_request_reviewers`); route `dispatch`; ⛔ no MCP write. Bare REST per `rest-channel.md:49`: `PUT .../pulls/{n}/update-branch` (used once; the merge commit it made is authored by the seat's personal account — #22052). CI re-runs: MCP `actions_run_trigger rerun_failed_jobs` answers 201 for the seat (REST 403).
- Landing: Tier S = at-tier `## Contract review` PASS in seat, then `check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0 + `check-governed-merges --pr N` exit 3 reading Tier S, then the relay flip; the ready flip re-triggers the label-sensitive `Governed Surface Queue Guard` (observed 9 minutes). A Tier H PR may be flipped ready and armed by the approving human; the seat's close-out is unchanged.
- Predecessor-dependent PR (landing-operations §C), as practised on #22002: the body carries the expected-red list and the release condition; after the predecessor merges, one `update-branch`, then a successor `## Contract review` naming the new head, then the Tier terminal continues; when every check is green the parked section becomes a synced note.
- Filing: `filing-gate.md:29` — three cards per fire; ten cards this shift went out over four fires with accelerators carrying the overflow. `triage-duties.md:34` / `:64` — a `tooling` card's first line carries `Unblocks: #N` or names the guarded surface, or a maintainer instruction quoted verbatim, else triage closes it while the lane's queue holds an undispatched P0/P1 (#21915).
- Liveness baseline measured this shift (`mode:subagent`, S/M governed-text cards): dispatch → draft PR 32 / 35 / 49 minutes; the 45-minute probe threshold held without a probe. Queue latency observed: enqueue → MERGED 27, 24 and 34 minutes; a GitHub Actions incident on 2026-10-07 afternoon left a required aggregate uncreated on one run (#22076's note) and rejected branch pushes with HTTP 500 for about an hour — both cleared on their own.
- Platform readings this shift: (1) a relay `issue_patch` carrying `body` on a PR number stores the bytes identical — no footer appended; (2) `Validate Package Dependencies` is path-filtered and inherits `main`'s OSV red (#22013 fixed; the PR-side judgment is #22082); (3) a type-check lane could be cancelled at checkout by a ten-minute wall (#22020, fixed by #22033; root cause #22034); (4) `pm:seat` `list_issues` with `body` overflows, and MCP multi-label `list_issues` is a union — REST `labels=a,b` for AND; (5) a shell variable holding backticked text expands them — claim text goes through files; (6) `gh api --paginate` breaks through the proxy — loop `&page=N` and stop on the RAW page length; (7) `gh api --jq .body` appends one newline — strip it before a whole-body `issue_patch`; (8) a subagent's transcript does not survive a container restart — research agents persist their findings to scratchpad files as they go; (9) an unquoted heredoc expands `$` and backticks — card bodies go through quoted heredocs with placeholders substituted afterwards.
- Timers: Routine `trig_01AGpv4wMw88KexCH41wPrGH` (next fire at :57 lands inside the dev's 32–49-minute baseline window); no accelerator armed; the dev's completion notification is the primary wake-up. No PR subscription is live until the dev's draft PR exists.
